about_section.title: About Us
about_section.second_description: At Agronexus Capital, we promote connectivity and sustainable development in the fields of agriculture, energy, and minerals...
about_section.third_description: As a strategic bridge between innovative businesses and investors, Agronexus Capital provides capital, technology, and necessary resources to optimize growth performance and create sustainable value for the entire ecosystem.

vision_mission_section.vision_description: With pioneering aspirations and a sustainable development strategy, Agronexus Capital aims to become the leading Green Financial Investment Group in the region with international stature, bringing Vietnamese agricultural brands to the world.

mission_items.item1: through investment in comprehensive agricultural service hubs
mission_items.item2_strong: Prevent resource wastage, enhance land use efficiency
mission_items.item3_strong: Establish a platform to help businesses optimize costs
mission_items.item3: by investing in the development of smart logistics and warehousing systems.
mission_items.item4_strong: Build Agronexus ecosystem brands to achieve international stature
mission_items.item4: to align with the strategic direction of the Party and State, elevating the national brand.
mission_items.item5_strong: Contribute to realizing Vietnam's Net Zero 2050 goal
mission_items.item5: through green investment strategies and carbon-neutral development.

core_values_section.title: Core Values
core_values_section.Commitment_description: Committed to delivering real value to investors, partners and the community.
core_values_section.Collaboration_description: Partnering for sustainable development with investors and businesses.
core_values_section.Sustainability_description: Balancing business development, investor and business benefits with environmental protection and social responsibility.
core_values_section.Innovation_description: Pioneering in green technology, innovating creative solutions, improving efficiency and quality of products and services.

agriculture.title: Agriculture
agriculture.investment_content: Applying high technology from cultivation to deep processing aimed at the global market.

smart_warehouse.title: Smart Agricultural Warehouse
smart_warehouse.description: Smart warehouses are storage systems that use advanced technologies such as automation, AI, and IoT to optimize management, distribution, and tracking of goods. Smart warehouses can automate the process of receiving, shipping, and inspecting goods, helping to minimize errors and enhance operational efficiency while reducing costs and storage time.

high_tech_farm.title: High-tech Farm Chain
high_tech_farm.description: Developing a chain of high-tech farms across Vietnam, specializing in high-value vegetables and fruits for both export and domestic markets.

energy.title: Energy
energy.investment_content: Vietnam is transitioning from traditional energy sources to solar power, wind power, and biomass, ensuring sustainable energy sources, reducing emissions, and promoting green growth.

project1.description: A chain of energy stations combined with rest stops and logistics in strategic locations, integrating utility services, energy, accommodation, F&B, and mini eco-tourism areas, aiming to become a model transportation-commercial center in the southern coastal region.

project2.description: The energy station chain combined with rest stops and logistics is a project integrating gas stations, electric charging stations, warehousing, utility services, and vehicle maintenance areas, aiming to become a key trade - logistics - energy - consumption connection point in the southwestern border region.

minerals.title: Minerals
minerals.investment_content: The minerals industry (tiles, building stones, sand, metals, etc.) has great potential thanks to abundant reserves and high quality in Vietnam. The application of high technology in mining and processing helps increase resource value, optimize efficiency, and reduce environmental impact.

aquaculture.title: Aquaculture
aquaculture.investment_content: The aquaculture sector is a strategic export industry of Vietnam, with great potential from natural advantages. The application of high technology in farming and processing is opening up a sustainable development direction, enhancing value and global competitiveness.

logistics.title: Warehouse - Port - Logistics
logistics.investment_content: The Warehouse - Port - Logistics industry plays a strategic logistics role for the entire agricultural - industrial - import-export supply chain.

services_list.port: International Port - Domestic Port - Dry Port Services.

port_services.title: International Port - Domestic Port - Dry Port Services
port_services.description: Connecting the green supply chain from international ports to ICDs (inland container depots) helps reduce logistics costs and increase resource efficiency.

warehouse_services.title: Warehouse and Distribution Center Services
warehouse_services.description: Smart warehouse system integrating cold chain technology and product origin management.

transport_services.title: Transportation Services
transport_services.description: Transportation connecting the supply chain from processing centers such as high-tech farm chains and integrated rest stop chains.

esg.title: Sustainable Development
esg.intro_description: Agro Nexus Capital aims to create sustainable value through investment projects that meet ESG criteria (Environmental, Social, Governance). With the mission of "greening" the supply chain, we connect capital, technology, and intelligence to promote organic farming, reduce emissions, protect resources, and ensure transparent management, contributing to value optimization for investors and communities.
